boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's mi_dma_gxcommand.c, 0x0205a21c..0x0205a448: 3 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt, each identified by its body against pret's pokediamond MI_dma_gxcommand.c. MI_SendGXCommandAsync runs the callback at once for length 0; otherwise it waits for !MIi_GXDmaParams.isBusy and for the FIFO to be under half full, fills MIi_GXDmaParams, calls MI_WaitDma, and with IRQs disabled saves GXSTAT's FIFO interrupt condition and the GXFIFO handler, sets the under-half condition, installs MIi_FIFOCallback, enables the GXFIFO IRQ and calls it once. MIi_FIFOCallback DMAs min(length, 0x1d8) bytes to the FIFO through MIi_DmaSetParams (DMAStartTransfer), and for the last chunk asks for the DMA interrupt and registers MIi_DMACallback through OSi_EnterDmaCallback. MIi_DMACallback disables the GXFIFO IRQ, restores the saved condition and handler, clears isBusy and runs the caller's callback.

Order: pret's file defines MI_SendGXCommand, MI_SendGXCommandAsync, MIi_FIFOCallback and MIi_DMACallback in that order. MI_SendGXCommand is in ITCM (src/MI_SendGXCommand.c, 0x01ffde98). mwccarm emits the other three in reverse, so MIi_DMACallback is lowest. This SDK has no MIi_CheckDma0SourceAddress, and MI_SendGXCommandAsyncFast is not in the ROM.
BOTTOM EDGE: DMASyncFillTransfer (MI_DmaFill32, ends 0x0205a21c), the highest function of mi_dma.c (arm9/MI_Dma).
TOP EDGE: MultiStore16 (CpuClear16) at 0x0205a448, the lowest function of mi_memory.c (arm9/MI_Memory).
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/MI_Dma: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.

func_0205a21c, func_0205a290 and func_0205a358 were renamed MIi_DMACallback, MIi_FIFOCallback and MI_SendGXCommandAsync from their bodies in this change, and the bss block data_020a6460 MIi_GXDmaParams. symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence.
Text-only: MIi_GXDmaParams is .bss and stays in the bss link.
